name: trader-journal-plugin
description: Persian/RTL premium journal-first trading workspace for Obsidian: daily commitment, fast trade capture, sensory-cognitive journaling, multi-account risk tracking, structured screenshots, analytics charts, and weekly/monthly reports.

scripts.build: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node validate-bundle.mjs
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
